summary: Lowe's is among the retailers (with Amazon and Shein) in coverage of Instagram's growing affiliate link tools.

items.title: Instagram expands affiliate commerce tools with Amazon, Shein and Lowe's links
items.why: Instagram's affiliate links are widening beyond Amazon to more retailers, so creators will have more stores to choose from inside the post.
